note: Schoenfeld residual tests (survival::cox.zph) reject the PH assumption for every covariate except HER2 and age; for CS p = 1.991e-14 and for the global test p = 1.069e-21. The CS x log(1+t) interaction and period-specific HRs (period 1: 0-24, 2: 24-60, 3: >60 months) characterise the time-dependence of the CS effect; period p-values are Wald tests of the period-specific CS coefficient against HR = 1. HRs above 1 indicate that higher CS carries higher hazard in that period.
